title: Maintenance Event
description: A vehicle maintenance or service event ingested by the maintenance-vehicle-health-ingestion service. Represents a single visit to a garage, dealership, or a self-reported service entry.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this maintenance event.

vehicle_id.description: Identifier of the vehicle that was serviced.

service_date.description: ISO-8601 date on which the service was performed.

odometer_km.description: Odometer reading in kilometres at the time of service.

part_name.description: Name or OEM part number of the replaced part.

parts_replaced.description: List of parts replaced during the service. May be empty if no parts were replaced.

source.description: How the maintenance record was sourced.

items.description: URI pointing to an uploaded invoice, receipt, or inspection report.

document_refs.description: References to supporting documents in object storage (optional).
